title: Payments Policy on Refunds of Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
This payments policy governs every refund of a Cleaning and Damage Fees charge.

## Clauses in force

1. **Destination and reference.** Refunds return to the original payment method and always name the fee charge they return.
2. **Partial refunds.** A partial refund is made only when a charged assessment is moved to a lower level while it is disputed or after it was upheld; the assessment's status at the time is therefore disputed or upheld.
3. **Full refunds.** A full refund returns the fee charged less anything already refunded on the assessment (every full and partial refund already booked on it), and is made only when the assessment is reversed.
4. **The driver's payout.** When a refund is made for any reason other than a first-incident courtesy, the reporting driver's payout on the amount returned is taken back; a courtesy refund leaves the driver's payout in place.

## Retired clause

The former clause on the amount of a partial refund — "it equals the fee at the old level less the fee at the new level" — is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for level-difference refunds.

## Refunds at a glance

| Kind of refund | Assessment status when made | Amount | Reporting driver's payout on the amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Partial | disputed or upheld, after a move to a lower level | per the current basis for level-difference refunds | taken back |
| Full, other than a courtesy | reversed | fee charged less anything already refunded | taken back |
| Full, as a first-incident courtesy | reversed | fee charged less anything already refunded | kept by the driver |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A fee of $100.00 was charged, and a partial refund of $40.00 has already been made on that charge. If the assessment is then reversed, the full refund is $100.00 less $40.00, that is $60.00, returned to the original card against the same fee charge.

superseded_clauses: it equals the fee at the old level less the fee at the new level (partial_refund_basis)
